''See also: [[Akura Pride Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Pride is a member of the [[Akura clan]], a powerful family known for their mastery of [[shadow madra]]. He is the son of the [[Monarch]] [[Akura Malice]] and the younger brother of the talented [[Akura Mercy]]. Despite his high lineage, Pride is described as being shorter than many others and has historically been unpopular among certain clan members. He possesses a temperament characterized by intense rage, a tendency to glare, and a defiant attitude that often borders on arrogance. In terms of combat and role, Pride utilizes [[Enforcer techniques]] and has been seen manifesting black tattoos on his skin when releasing his spirit. He has served as a leader for the [[Akura backup team]] during significant events, such as the [[Uncrowned King Tournament]]. Throughout his development, he has demonstrated a strong sense of responsibility toward his family and sister, even accepting opportunities for [[advancement]] beyond his world out of a sense of duty. His history includes rigorous training from a young age and participation in high-stakes conflicts, including encounters involving Overlords and the [[Abidan]].}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Uncrowned King tournament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Pride is the brother of [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c13">''Underlord'', chapter 13</ref> He will eventually be notified that his sister is participating in the [[Uncrowned King Tournament|Uncrowned King tournament]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref>}}

</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|A member of the [[Akura clan|Akura family]], Pride is identified by swirling black tattoos on his face and neck that serve as his [[Goldsign]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3">''Uncrowned'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c14">''Uncrowned'', chapter 14</ref> Though he has not yet advanced to [[Archlord]], he possesses a [[Path]] containing four available techniques which he uses exclusively for [[Enforcer]] abilities.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c3" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c7">''Uncrowned'', chapter 7</ref> This short and glaring individual is a servant who accompanies [[Lindon]], with their rooms being connected.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c6">''Uncrowned'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c10">''Uncrowned'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13">''Uncrowned'', chapter 13</ref> During the tournament, Pride ranked twenty-second and demonstrated his ability to attack with his fists.<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c12">''Uncrowned'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13" /> After running ahead, he weathered a tide of fire from [[Sopharanatoth|Sophara]] and was eventually found panting and bleeding on the sand next to [[Lindon]].<ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c13" /><ref name="cradle-07-uncrowned-c15">''Uncrowned'', chapter 15</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Wintersteel era}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Akura clan|Akura]] Pride is an [[Underlord]] who directs traffic on the docks and shares a connecting room with [[Lindon]] and [[Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c3">''Wintersteel'', chapter 3</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5">''Wintersteel'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13">''Wintersteel'', chapter 13</ref> As the brother of [[Akura Mercy]] and a member of [[Lindon]]'s team, he is currently finishing up his acolytes.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c5" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c12">''Wintersteel'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /> A master of [[Enforcer techniques]] who possesses [[bloodline armor]], Pride stands outside [[Lindon]]'s [[Script|script]] over a campfire.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c13" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c14">''Wintersteel'', chapter 14</ref> The son of a [[Monarch]], he is someone [[Malice]] would sacrifice for her family.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c22">''Wintersteel'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24">''Wintersteel'', chapter 24</ref> After emerging from the [[Shadow|shadow]] of a building, Pride was seen arguing with [[Mercy]] near the [[evacuation portal]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c24" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c25">''Wintersteel'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c26">''Wintersteel'', chapter 26</ref> Pride and his sister were ambushed by the [[Sage of Red Faith]], [[Calan Archer]], [[Yan Shoumei]], [[Brother Aekin]], and three Overlords of [[Redmoon Hall]] sent by [[Reigan Shen]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27">''Wintersteel'', chapter 27</ref> During the encounter where he was surrounded by enemies, Pride was in bad shape with a mangled left arm, though he ultimately survived the battle.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c27" /><ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c28">''Wintersteel'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Threshold: Stories from Cradle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Associated with the name [[Akura clan|Akura]], [[Akura clan|Akura]] Pride was brought along by [[Lindon]] during his ascension.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 10</ref> He was subsequently taken by his half-brother, [[Fury]], to undergo training.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" /> Pride possesses physical parameters that exceed those of the average recruit, characterized by his status as a three-star [[Wolf]], two-star [[Ghost]], two-star [[Fox]], and one-star [[Titan]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" /> While he does not fight for amusement, he has implied that specific devices within the [[Wolf Division]] require payment to activate.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c10" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c12">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 12</ref>}}
